reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A67E4 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/mathsys/004A67E4-MathSys_Invoke7_4A67E4.cpp at sha256 58baa384eb5c90518238aeb13f9ffaa85edb8aef8360cc0ca65001afc5631542 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t __convention MathSys_Invoke7_4A67E4("regparm")(char* param_1, int16_t param_2, void* param_3, void* param_4, int32_t param_5);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

Uninitialized locals model the entry registers.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t __convention("regparm")(char* arg1, int16_t arg2, void* arg3 @ 0x4, void* arg4 @ 0x8, int32_t arg5 @ 0xc)" at 0x004A67E4; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a67e4 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A67E4 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t __convention MathSys_Invoke7_4A67E4("regparm")(char* param_1, int16_t param_2, void* param_3, void* param_4, int32_t param_5);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
BN and r2 agree on 12 blocks/16 edges at the recorded entry, but the first 8 bytes are not a plausible function prologue; the true entry may be 0x4A67EC.
